system_prompt_style.note: The system prompt of the ColPackAgent standalone agent is not described. The paired repository is Claude Code, which is not the ColPackAgent repo (github.com/ljding94/ColPackAgent). The paper says the skill is Markdown with YAML frontmatter.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: A fifth tool returns the live set of supported dimensions, shapes, ensembles, tunable parameters, and incompatible mixture rules for the agent to know about the capabilities of the tools.
env_context_strategy.note: The agent queries a capabilities tool. Coded from prose only.

context_compaction.note: The ColPackAgent source is not in the bundle.

observation_format.evidence_quote: structured artifacts are written so that the next stage, or any external tool, can read what happened in a canonical form rather than parse free-form chat

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) provides a standard way for an agent to call external tools through typed inputs and structured outputs
tool_call_format.note: MCP tool calls. The standalone agent's parser is not shown.

tool_count.evidence_quote: Each stage is exposed through one tool: a setup tool, a planning tool, an execution tool, and an analysis tool. A fifth tool returns the live set of supported dimensions
tool_count.note: The count is the domain MCP tools. The host agent's own tools are not counted.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: The MCP server is implemented as a Python wrapper around the colpack package.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: autonomously runs Monte Carlo simulations of colloidal packing through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool server and an agent skill

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: the skill encodes a four-stage workflow contract
loop_primitives.note: The skill prescribes the stage order setup, plan, execute, analyze. The agent calls tools reactively.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote:
This benchmark provides a stage-level check of how reliably
different models follow the setup, planning, and analysis workflow.
planning_granularity.note: Planning is a stage of a skill-guided workflow driven by stage-specific prompts; no stored plan object shown in the excerpts.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: whether as a standalone agent or inside an existing agent system

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: whether as a standalone agent or inside an existing agent system
delegation_mechanism.note: Absence inferred from prose, without a registry. Treat as weak.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: The agent advances one workflow stage per turn and waits for explicit user confirmation before invoking each tool.
human_in_loop.note: Interactive vs autonomous mode is selected by the skill heuristics.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: During a simulation, the state for a study persists under a single working directory.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Skills are Markdown files with a YAML frontmatter header.

self_verification.note: The analysis tool has an auto-equilibration check. This is a domain check, not harness verification of the agent's work.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: iterates the simulation loop autonomously until producing a research report

timeouts.note: The execution tools run asynchronously to avoid client timeouts.

tracing.note: The paper mentions a run summary in the benchmark but gives no format.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: the eval runner substitutes with a concrete working-directory path before the model sees the prompt
eval_hooks.note: The runner's presence in the repo is not verified.

guardrails.evidence_quote: the setup tool enforces the same rule so that disallowed mixtures are rejected before any simulation is launched

target_domain.evidence_quote: an agent framework that autonomously runs Monte Carlo simulations of colloidal packing

open_source.evidence_quote: The colpack package and corresponding agent skill are available at the GitHub repository

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: we route all model calls through OpenRouter with the Google Vertex provider selected
